source.note: Includes the shared import-free requirement coverage rubric; no additional Git, model or legacy-dispatch dependency. 444: the source-review batching split three helpers out of loaded modules and added its snapshot cache. 454: 1078bf60 split publication writers out of state.mjs into ten modules (+17 KB eager source). 456: main 1d40e1de already loaded 455 without a recorded raise; agent-output-folder.mjs, the leaf that keeps agent results in the checkout's Git-excluded .sflow/out, makes 456. 457: fddafbe0 added approval-fallback.mjs, the leaf that names the nearest step with approvers when the owning step has none (no Git, model or dispatch import). 459: SDA M1 (fa3094b83) added two leaves without a recorded raise: outcome-classes.mjs (constants with no import; util.mjs gives every error its outcome class) and source-inspection.mjs (the local-read facade; SDA M2 made its one Git query registry read lazy, so it imports only util and process-result). 460: SDA M3 adds lease-liveness.mjs, the lease owner proof every subject lock reads (machine identity and the owner's start time; no Git, model or dispatch import). 461: SDA M4 adds the lifecycle authority adapter and its contract (sda/story-branch-authority.mjs, sda/lifecycle-authority-contract.mjs, sda/shared-state-contract.mjs); the publication writer they wrap loads only on a transition. 462: SF Guard M3 adds presence/counted.mjs, the import-free leaf through which each person-step family reader counts only verified records (no Git, model or dispatch import; the signer and verifier load only on a Story SF Guard requires).
